messages:
maria: Heads up — RC window in ~6h. Quick favor: please compress your changelog entries to a single sentence and append a single component tag in parentheses. I'm assembling a prefill PR to capture everyone's one-liners. Reply if you need more time or if your change needs special wording.

release-bot: prefill PR opened: https://git.company/release-notes/prefill-2539123456 — add your one-liner to the PR body. :robot_face:

jonathan: on it. will squash my two runtime items into one line.

sam: quick question — allowed form: 
```
runtime: reduce kv cache pressure for long sessions (eng-runtime)
```
and ok to include short perf numbers? e.g., ~20% CPU drop.

maria: yes — that form is perfect. If you include a metric, keep it parenthetical and tiny: e.g., "~20% CPU". main rule: 1 short sentence, component tag at end. no paragraphs.

lina: fyi i have an infra hotfix that needs wording review. can i grab 1 extra hour before cut?

maria: if it's a small hotfix (1 PR, low-risk), we can allow +1h but please flag the PR with `release/late-allow`. anything bigger needs approval from release lead.

jonathan: also tagging components helps the console dashboards — use the canonical component names (eng-runtime, eng-sre, devex, docs, api).

anna: what about version bump lines? do we list them in changelog or keep separate?

maria: version bumps only need a terse line in the changelog if they represent user-visible changes. Use this pattern: 
```
bump: v1.84.0 -> v1.85.0 (minor)
```
If it's just packaging churn, omit it.

sam: added my line to the prefill. ping if wording needs nit edits.

lina: adding hotfix line now, marking PR with `release/late-allow`. thanks.

release-bot: rc build scheduled in ~3h. Reminder: prefill PR closes automatically 30m before RC build.

maria: thanks everyone — i'll do a quick sweep 45m before RC to tidy language. pls keep entries short and component-tagged. :thumbsup:
